title: saucectl AI Test Authoring runner configuration
description: Configuration file for running Sauce Labs AI-authored tests using saucectl

defaults.description: Settings that are applied onto every suite by default, if no value is set on a suite explicitly.

suites.description: The set of AI-authored test cases to run. Each entry references a test suite by ID or exact name, or lists test cases explicitly.

name.description: The name of the suite, which will be reflected in the test results.

testSuiteId.description: The ID of the AI Test Authoring test suite whose test cases to run.

testSuiteName.description: The exact name of the AI Test Authoring test suite whose test cases to run. Resolved at run time; an ambiguous name is an error.

testCases.description: Explicit list of test case IDs to run.

tags.description: Only run test cases of the referenced suite that carry at least one of these tags. Ignored when testCases is set.

targets.description: Browsers or devices to run against, overriding each test case's stored run targets. When omitted, the stored targets apply.

capabilities.description: W3C WebDriver capabilities, passed through unchanged, e.g. browserName, platformName, browserVersion, appium:deviceName.
